name: Бзикер
implementation_status: City v14: supplied idle and movement artwork is the canonical character basis; female shorter/narrower variant, source-textured poses and hair-only customization; live Telegram deployment pending.

confirmed.platform: Telegram Mini App through bot; loopback demo available

profile.name: 1–32 visible characters; fixed after first registration; new nicknames unique after NFKC/casefold
profile.avatar: shared normalized raster atlas; nearest-neighbor SVG/Canvas rendering; saved customization IDs retained
profile.mobile_builder: pinned avatar and nickname, collapsed gender after selection, internally scrolling category catalog and palettes

confirmed.meeting: optional HTTPS link; no Zoom API
confirmed.invites: separate player/jury/team codes plus addressed phone invitations; server chooses role/team permission

visual.environment: 2D top-down three-quarter pixel RPG: roof/top/side planes, material shading, depth-sorted actors and props; modern BZIK buildings with local colour accents
visual.people_style: shared24x36 compact RPG, four directions and eight phase walk cycle; stable face/head; phone overlay preserves sitting
visual.color_accents: pale modern city, muted vegetation and local avatar/clan/menu colours
visual.start_transfer: all participants atomically assigned to arena by server; any participant screen follows authorized arena
visual.finish_return: all participant arena records persist city
visual.lighting: 1200-second day/night cycle with local lamps; optional local day/night view

question_selection.first_chooser: first created team / first joined player

answer_policy.first: atomic captain/individual buzz; winning unit alone submits

blind_review.dialog: full contextual question, full text, 0–10 buttons

controls_desktop: I / physical I on Cyrillic layout: inventory
world.layout: connected bent/ring roads, central plaza, southern park/lake and unified eastern clan quarter
world.online_badge: actual count plus small онлайн; no denominator

spawn.location: west railway separated from city; approximately 8 seconds of continuous walking to welcome sign
spawn.returning_accounts: retain authorized last position separately from expiring online presence
spawn.migration: Existing map-v5 migration remains; v11 does not change the schema or reset valid saved city positions.

world.fast_travel: actual server coordinates via full map and phone; active matches and private base rights enforced
world.object_taps: nearby doors and benches dispatch the same action as E/button

public_interiors.counter: nearby feature opens existing phone application
public_interiors.exit: nearby exit returns to corresponding city door
public_interiors.presence: same-room real accounts with per-player interior_id/scene_id
public_interiors.restore: stable seat and phone pose retained after room refit; obstructed positions repaired locally within same room
public_interiors.decorative_collisions: all physical solid props project exactly to shared JSON solids; suspended panels have no floor supports

world.rendering: cached ground, separate objects sorted with actors by foot depth; pixel materials and consistent light
world.phone_open: independent overlay flag, no coordinate/scene/bench reset
world.transport: walking initially; cars, skateboard, horse, bus and metro future
world.ground_cache: half-resolution world chunks, native labels and sprites, bounded cache

water.pedestrians: position and full segment cannot enter/cross water
water.boats: one occupant each, water only, authoritative occupancy
water.disembark: near own water dock, returns to dry boarding point
water.fast_travel: must disembark; only authorised destination points bypass pedestrian path check

city_v12.collision_geometry: foot supports, shared by browser/server; crowns and light are not walls
city_v12.inventory_position: flush before use; retain sitting and coordinates; no phone pose
city_v12.road_pier_label: boat pictogram, no permanent pier/fishing wording
city_v12.character_actions: articulated draw poses for pickup/throw/pet/eat/drink/eight-stage smoke

base.building_selection: leader constructs a vacant plot while nearby; >=4 real members; immutable plot/style/exterior color
base.occupancy: one active clan per plot; new clans unassigned; archive releases plot
base.premium_furniture: owned shop item required; standard furniture remains available
base.placement: 12×8 grid,0/90 rotation, shared footprints, solid items cannot overlap; rug can be beneath furniture; legacy5 items keep1×1 footprint
base.guest_access: addressed invitation accepted by guest; no clan membership/editor rights; active_base distinct from my_clan
base.interactive_seats: sofa, chair, armchair, bed and dining table according to shared seat anchors
base.exterior_color: independent of clan flag; 32 swatches plus strict #RRGGBB custom/native colour picker
base.legacy_houses: assigned houses retain exterior and progress without requiring four members
base.eyedropper: EyeDropper where supported; local solid-fill sampling from house preview otherwise

clans.rating: raw summed quiz points at official game finish; one ledger row per clan/match

phone.timestamps: server Unix seconds converted to milliseconds
phone.polling: one visible-open phone loop; paused on close/hidden/navigation; preserves typed text/focus/caret
phone.trigger: small square phone icon bottom beside action button
phone.pose: phone_open overlay above existing sit/idle/smoke, looking at upper-chest phone without changing location

sound.style: original Web Audio square/triangle/digital-noise chip effects
sound.payment: original confirmation after successful virtual purchase, inspired by a modern payment cue, not an Apple Pay recording or verified identical sound
sound.notification: first baseline quiet; new unread/social invitation only; closed phone polling; hidden tab/mute suppress sound

economy.hud: balance by minimap and in phone
economy.quest_claims: one-time fact eligibility plus daily30 cap; claim is explicit and persisted
economy.cigarette: virtual item, only usable in smoking zone, 8-second pose
economy.transfer: recipient accepts actual nearby smoking request, atomically transfers one item

fishing.catch: one fish in persistent inventory per successful cast, idempotent catch
fishing.requires: near lake spot and owned rod

pets.equip: one selected owned pet, follows owner and shared with nearby players

inventory_ui.placement: separate bottom drawer, never opens phone
inventory_ui.stacking: identical item types share one slot
inventory_ui.wardrobe_and_base_furniture: owned collections remain in their catalogues
inventory_ui.full_bag: new carried item type rejected atomically; existing stack allowed

cards.poker: 2–4 players, five-card draw, one exchange or keep, fixed ante, hand rank and tie settlement
cards.blackjack: 1–4 players with dealer standing on all 17; ace 1/11; win 2x including natural, push refund
cards.private_cards: own hand only until final reveal; dealer one visible card before finish
cards.start: server atomically checks funds and assigns every participant to card scene

slots.idempotency: same saved account nonce and ante replay once; unknown response recovered before casino UI even at zero balance

cards.jury_blackout: waiting roster unavailable if any participant gets unfinished jury duty; frontend clears cached roster on denial
cards.history: tables and settlement persist in SQLite
cards.durak: 2–4 players;36 cards; six initial; bottom trump; legal attack/defend/pickup/pass; matched-rank throw-ins limited by initial defender hand/max6; attacker-first/defender-last draw; final loser and idempotent shared pot

account.login: 3–32 ASCII characters; first letter or digit, then a-z0-9_.-; case-insensitive
account.password: 8–128 characters; salted scrypt; not returned or stored by frontend
account.registration: new players create credentials before avatar; existing demo can claim same account without losing progress
account.session: HttpOnly same-origin cookie; rotated session/CSRF on register/login/logout
account.cross_device: same credentials restore same persistent account

living_city_v7.visual_direction: Original detailed pixel art following user-supplied proportions, materials and depth; modern neutral buildings with muted vegetation/accents
living_city_v7.all_outdoor_ground: grass and asphalt with paved sidewalks/forecourts
living_city_v7.casino_poker: pixel interior around seated participants; private hands stay private
living_city_v7.step_sound: soft contact tone without raw noise layer

demo_bank.status: authored demonstration content; user sets work context

architecture.telegram_identity: server HMAC validation of official initData; rotated session/CSRF
architecture.public: Telegram auth, canonical HTTPS PUBLIC_URL, Secure cookies, reverse proxy preserves canonical Host
architecture.demo: loopback development mode; frontend first entry uses password account, old demo profiles can claim credentials

open_decisions: actual work theme selected by game host
future game duration/timer and special rounds
leader rewards and cross-game rating normalization

sources.title: Latest user-confirmed unified city, railway spawn, side quests, economy, shops, palettes and cards brief

city_motion_environment_v10.request: Independently review the whole map, correct strong walking shake and add more lamps and meaningful street details.
city_motion_environment_v10.peer_interpolation: distance / movement_speed, minimum 120 ms; no smoothing for phone, seating or scene changes
city_motion_environment_v10.decorative_street_props: Full visible bounds and depth are defined; these props do not add new movement collisions.
city_motion_environment_v10.browser_tab_policy: Reuse one existing tab; no new tabs; reset test viewport and restore original game.

city_curb_fields_arrival_v11.request: Review similar pavement overlaps across the whole city; fill empty fields with trees; move railway closer; add city details.
city_curb_fields_arrival_v11.decorative_collisions: No new movement solids; full rendered bounds are checked for placement.

character_inventory_v13.request: Redraw all characters according to supplied reference screenshots and make inventory icons colorful.
character_inventory_v13.reference_basis: User supplied screenshots, with source copies and visual comparison in docs. Not a complete source sprite atlas.
